The 'structural collapse' of the rear sight is a significant fidelity issue for a mechanical object. I will maintain the severity ratings but note that the 'compression' artifact is likely a symptom of AI smoothing rather than actual JPEG compression.

The semantic mismatch between the visual generation (SMG) and the class label (Assault Rifle) prevents a perfect score, despite the classifier's approval. 5/7 testable checkpoints passed.
